doc.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Upcoming tours with Chick Corea and Kathleen Battle
summary: Summer tour in Chick Corea's Bud Powell tribute and later concerts with Kathleen Battle, whose CD he played on; practicing on the gig.

bands.name: Chick Corea's Bud Powell tribute group

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: You’ve got some good looking things in your future I see, playing with some notable people coming up?

I hope so. Yeah, well actually I’ll be touring with Chick Corea this summer. He’s putting together a tribute to Bud Powell. We’re going to go out with a group and we’re going to play pretty much all Bud Powell music. And the band consists of myself, Roy Haynes is playing drums, Wallace Roney is playing trumpet, Joshua Redman is going to do most of the tour, but Kenny Garrett is going to play saxophone on a few concerts. So I’m really looking forward to playing with Chick this summer. Oh, that’s going to be a blast. And also I’ll be touring with Kathleen Battle at the end of the year and that’ll be interesting because I had a chance to work with Kathleen on her latest, I guess it’s her latest CD on the SONY Classics label in which she did a lot of very different — it turned out to be a great project — she did some Brazilian music, some spiritual, some stuff that’s what she said was not strictly classical. So I played on it, Cyrus Chestnut played piano, James Carter plays saxophone and Grover Washington and it turned out to be a really marvelous project. So we’re going to do a few concerts at the end of the year with that. And so in between Chick and Kathleen, I’ll be touring with my band.
Quite a schedule. Do you have any time to practice?
Got to practice while you’re out.
Yeah. Miles said you practice on the gig.
